notes_for_successor: Verdict FAIL 5/10. Round 2 genuinely closed three of round 1's four orphan models (overheard_from, q.directions, opens_by.topic), the 40/40 and no-purse headlines reproduce to the digit, and AR-3 survives a harder end-to-end test than the builder applied (all 40 signatures take res_sign_the_clause). The gap is that findability was measured at QuestEngine.open(), which has no presence term: 9 of 94 quest givers are talkable anywhere and 0 of the 35 quests in the headline has a giver in the world. Also: 8 of 31 gates now carry disposition_min 0 and cannot refuse (standing floor-clamps at 0 over 24,960 samples); tightest real margin 0.643 at Q-MAIN-08 for naga/interior; 11 of 11 entry_topics cycles close on one NPC over 28 quests; "eleven" at 171x the Morrowind rate in the new prose. Two tools minted and declared, both with red controls. utility-findability.mjs --state is broken and should be fixed before anyone cites a per-state number.
